lore.common: Hums in the window and drips a little water onto the pavement below.
lore.uncommon: Blows cold air straight at whoever sits in the one comfy chair.
lore.rare: Breathes frost on anyone who says 'it's a bit warm in here', and they walk out with icicles on their eyebrows.
lore.epic: Blew so hard in a heatwave that it pushed the whole house a metre into the shade. The postman now knocks on the wrong door.
lore.legendary: Blew a cold snap out of the window so big that it snowed on one street in August, and the children built a snowman in swimming shorts.

lore.common: Fizzes and spins in the bath, turning the water a surprising colour.
lore.uncommon: Leaves glitter in the bath that turns up on everyone for a week.
lore.rare: Fizzes in any water it touches, so the dog's bowl, the fish tank and the kettle all smell of lavender.
lore.epic: Turned the bath bright purple, and the person in it came out purple for the day.
lore.legendary: Fizzed so hard that it launched the bath through the roof like a rocket. The bather landed in next door's paddling pool, still holding the soap.

lore.common: Takes forty minutes to fill and four seconds to go cold the moment anyone gets in.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot at the tap end, so its bather sits at the other.
lore.rare: Gurgles rude noises down the plughole whenever a guest is in the bath, and everyone downstairs pretends not to hear.
lore.epic: Overflowed for so long that the kitchen below got a ceiling waterfall, and Dad stood under it with the shampoo.
lore.legendary: Sailed down the high street on bath night with its bather still in it, and stopped politely at every red light.

lore.common: Roars like a jet engine for ten seconds and makes a smoothie.
lore.uncommon: Walks across the counter on its own while it blends, always heading for the edge.
lore.rare: Sucks in anything left beside it, so the shopping list, a tea towel and Grandad's glasses came out as one green smoothie.
lore.epic: Launched its lid mid-blend, and the kitchen got a strawberry ceiling.
lore.legendary: Blended a thunderstorm on picnic day. Everyone got sunshine, plus a fizzy drink that rumbled.

lore.common: Turns every pen it fills into a slightly leaky pen, always in a white shirt pocket.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a blue ring on every desk it has ever stood on.
lore.rare: Refuses to be crossed out: every line struck through it turns into a neat underline instead.
lore.epic: Tipped over on the exam papers, and the whole class's answers ran together into one giant blue essay that got a B.
lore.legendary: Wrote a whole novel by itself overnight. The hero is a fountain pen, and it wins in the end.

lore.common: Gets used by one bird at a time, and that bird is always the biggest, grumpiest pigeon.
lore.uncommon: Gets so splashed by sparrows that it needs refilling twice a day.
lore.rare: Gives any bird that bathes in it a voice it can't control, so the crows now sing opera at five in the morning.
lore.epic: Froze solid one winter, and the ducks used it as an ice rink. A robin now gives skating lessons.
lore.legendary: Was so popular that a whole migrating flock changed its route south to stop by. They now spend the winter in the back garden.

lore.common: Clanks its handle every time it's set down on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Has a small crack that drips water into every shoe.
lore.rare: Is never fully empty: there is always one more splash left in it, aimed at the last dry sock.
lore.epic: Built a sandcastle so tall that the tide paused just to look at it.
lore.legendary: Scooped up the whole sea in one go at the beach, and only put it back when the lifeguard blew his whistle.

lore.common: Echoes back anything said into it, only a little bit slower.
lore.uncommon: Swallows every coin thrown in and never says what it did with them.
lore.rare: Answers any question shouted down it, but always with another question.
lore.epic: Hiccuped up every coin ever thrown into it, and the village fete was showered with pennies for an hour.
lore.legendary: Granted a boy's wish for 'a bucket of ice cream' exactly. The bucket is the size of a lake and is still on its way up.

lore.common: Sits under the drainpipe catching rain for the garden.
lore.uncommon: Gets a layer of leaves on top that turns the water slightly brown.
lore.rare: Sends a little rain cloud after anyone who forgets to water the plants, so they get the watering instead.
lore.epic: Overflowed so far in a storm that the garden gnome sailed past the kitchen window on a lettuce leaf.
lore.legendary: Collected one raindrop from every cloud in the sky, and now the weather has to ask its permission before it rains.

lore.common: Gets opened by a tin opener that always stops just before the last little bit.
lore.uncommon: Has a ring pull that always snaps off halfway round.
lore.rare: Heats itself the moment anyone nearby says 'I'm cold', so the supermarket soup aisle is always steaming.
lore.epic: Rolled out of a shopping bag at the top of a hill, and the whole bus queue chased it to the bottom.
lore.legendary: Was opened on the Moon by an astronaut, and the soup floated out in one perfect red ball. He drank it with a straw.

lore.common: Gurgles in the loft every time someone runs a tap downstairs.
lore.uncommon: Groans at night like a ghost when the pipes are filling.
lore.rare: Pushes water up instead of down, so the shower sometimes rains from the floor.
lore.epic: Burst on a frosty night, and the stairs turned into a waterfall the family slid down at breakfast.
lore.legendary: Held a whole lake in the loft without the ceiling sagging, and the family now goes upstairs to fish.

lore.common: Has a lid that dribbles coffee down the chin with every single sip.
lore.uncommon: Goes cold while its owner answers one quick email.
lore.rare: Spells its owner's name wrong in marker pen, and they answer to the wrong name for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Was left on a desk so long that it grew a skin and a small fan club.
lore.legendary: Woke a whole office so fast that they finished Friday's work by Monday lunchtime and had nothing to do all week.

lore.common: Gurgles and hisses every morning while a queue forms in front of it.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of beans just as the busiest person reaches the front.
lore.rare: Hisses gossip in its steam: every puff spells out who took the last biscuit.
lore.epic: Broke down one Monday, and the whole office was asleep by eleven.
lore.legendary: Brewed a coffee so strong that the town clock started ticking twice as fast. Lunch is now at half past nine.

lore.common: Unfolds with a creak and a clatter, and stands on three wobbly legs.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its legs shut when somebody is halfway through a shirt.
lore.rare: Raises itself one notch whenever nobody is looking, until the ironer needs a stepladder.
lore.epic: Snapped open at the top of the stairs, and the whole family surfed down to breakfast on it.
lore.legendary: Unfolded into a bridge when the river bridge closed, and the whole town crossed to work on its padded cover.

lore.common: Hums and sloshes after dinner, cleaning plates that somebody rinsed anyway.
lore.uncommon: Puts one fork through to the end of a cycle completely dirty.
lore.rare: Keeps one teaspoon from every wash somewhere inside itself, and now owns forty.
lore.epic: Was opened mid-cycle, and the steam fogged the whole kitchen like a sauna.
lore.legendary: Washed a whole bouncy castle in one cycle after a birthday party, and it came out folded and smelling of lemons.

lore.common: Turns its head slowly from side to side, giving everyone a turn of breeze.
lore.uncommon: Blows papers off the desk whenever it gets to the left side.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who talks into it sound like a robot for the rest of the day.
lore.epic: Spun so hard that it blew out the birthday candles from across the room before anyone could make a wish.
lore.legendary: Blew the clouds away from sports day so hard that it rained on the teachers' car park instead.

names.legendary: Hydros, Who Put Out the Sunset

lore.common: Stands on the pavement looking short and important, with a cap on its head.
lore.uncommon: Is visited by every dog on the street, every single day.
lore.rare: Senses a fire three streets away and soaks the barbecue before the sausages are done.
lore.epic: Burst its cap on a heatwave afternoon and floated the ice-cream van gently down the high street.
lore.legendary: Put out a sunset once because it looked like a fire. The town had to wait until morning for the next one.

lore.common: Wobbles on its thin stem every time someone says the word 'toast'.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by every elbow at every party.
lore.rare: Bubbles so hard that whoever holds it floats a few centimetres off the floor during the toast.
lore.epic: Popped all its bubbles at once in the middle of a wedding speech, and the burp echoed round the hall for a full minute.
lore.legendary: Clinked a note so pure that the chandelier answered, and now they sing a duet at every party.

lore.common: Rattles with ice and fruit juice, making the whole kitchen clatter.
lore.uncommon: Leaks a little juice from its lid whenever it's shaken too hard.
lore.rare: Turns anything poured into it into a milkshake, including the orange juice, the soup and Gran's tea.
lore.epic: Was shaken so hard at a party that it turned into a maraca, and the band kept it on stage until midnight.
lore.legendary: Mixed a fruit drink so cold that it snowed inside the glass, and the guests drank it wearing mittens.

lore.common: Holds water and the fingerprints of whoever drank from it last.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to its coaster when lifted, then drops it on the table with a clatter.
lore.rare: Fills itself back up to the brim whenever someone says they've had enough.
lore.epic: Was rung round its rim at dinner until the whole table joined in a song.
lore.legendary: Became so perfectly clear that it vanished altogether, and the family has been drinking from thin air ever since.

lore.common: Turns a chicken round and round so slowly that everyone watches it.
lore.uncommon: Drips juices into its tray, which smells delicious and looks dreadful.
lore.rare: Spins anything near it, so the till, the mop and the price signs all turn slowly round with the chickens.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the summer fair that two chickens flew off the spit and landed in the tombola.
lore.legendary: Turned the whole world round once by accident, and the town had two breakfasts that day.

lore.common: Hisses steam whenever it's set down, as if it's had enough.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a shiny patch on trousers when it gets too hot.
lore.rare: Presses clothes so flat that they could be posted under a door.
lore.epic: Pressed a crease so sharp into Dad's trousers that he cut the ribbon at the school fair with his knee.
lore.legendary: Ironed out every bump in the village road in one afternoon. The speed bumps have filed a complaint.

lore.common: Holds towels until somebody throws theirs on the floor instead.
lore.uncommon: Holds so many towels at once that none of them ever get dry.
lore.rare: Swaps everyone's towels in the night, so Dad dries himself on the tiny flannel.
lore.epic: Fired every towel off at once when the heating came on, and the dog came to breakfast wrapped like a burrito.
lore.legendary: Grew so many rails overnight that it became a ladder to the loft, and the family now climbs it to fetch the suitcases.

lore.common: Holds a cup of tea and a ring stain from every one before it.
lore.uncommon: Gets chipped on the handle but is still everyone's favourite.
lore.rare: Keeps tea hot only for its owner: anyone else who picks it up gets it stone cold.
lore.epic: Was left in the office sink so long that a goldfish moved in, and now it has its own name on the tea rota.
lore.legendary: Has been refilled so many times that it now holds tea on its own.

lore.common: Slurps loudly into mouths and splashes broth on every shirt.
lore.uncommon: Gets wrapped round the fork in a big messy knot.
lore.rare: Ties anyone's shoelaces together from across the table with one long noodle.
lore.epic: Was slurped so hard that the tablecloth went up with the last noodle, and the plates stayed exactly where they were.
lore.legendary: Was one noodle so long that it went round the world and came back to the same bowl. It still needed salt.

lore.common: Glows inside while the cake rises and everyone peeks through the door.
lore.uncommon: Is always hotter at the back, so one side of everything is crispy.
lore.rare: Turns its own dial up when nobody is looking, so every cake comes out a little more toasted than planned.
lore.epic: Baked a birthday cake that rose so high that it lifted the ceiling, and the upstairs bath ended up in the icing.
lore.legendary: Baked a loaf so big that the village moved into it for the winter. The front door is a crust.

lore.common: Holds cold lemonade with ice cubes clinking against its side.
lore.uncommon: Drips down its spout every time it's put back on the table.
lore.rare: Pours whatever drink someone secretly wants instead of the one they asked for, so Gran keeps getting hot chocolate.
lore.epic: Overflowed every glass at a picnic, and the ants had a lemonade party.
lore.legendary: Poured lemonade so smoothly that it filled a glass on the far side of the sports field without spilling a drop on the way.

lore.common: Holds the soap until someone reaches for it with a wet hand.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with a little puddle of soapy water that turns the soap soft.
lore.rare: Lets soap slide off so fast that it shoots across the bathroom floor.
lore.epic: Turned the bathroom floor into a skating rink of suds, and the family slid to school in their socks.
lore.legendary: Kept its grip on the soap through a storm that blew the whole bathroom away. The soap was still dry.

lore.common: Gurgles and clanks when the heating comes on in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Is always hot at the top and cold at the bottom.
lore.rare: Shrinks anything left on it by one size, including the school jumper and Dad's favourite socks.
lore.epic: Heated the bathroom so much one winter night that the house plants thought it was summer and grew bananas.
lore.legendary: Kept a house so warm that a polar bear left the Arctic and moved into the airing cupboard.

lore.common: Fills up with bathwater and squirts it straight into the ear of whoever squeezes it.
lore.uncommon: Always floats to the end of the bath away from the child.
lore.rare: Steers the bath like a boat, so the bather drifts to the tap end whether they like it or not.
lore.epic: Commanded such a fierce sea battle against the shampoo bottles that the bathroom floor sank under the waves.
lore.legendary: Let out one squeak so loud that the bathwater jumped out of the tub and landed back in again, still warm.

lore.common: Drips its tap once every few seconds, all night long.
lore.uncommon: Fills up with washing up whenever anyone turns their back.
lore.rare: Swallows rings, earrings and teaspoons down its plughole, then gurgles happily for hours.
lore.epic: Overflowed with bubbles during washing up, and the whole kitchen became a foam party.
lore.legendary: Unblocked itself with one mighty gulp, and every lost teaspoon in town came shooting back up the plughole.

lore.common: Pours tea in a long curve from its spout, mostly into the cup.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that rattles whenever the kettle boils, as if it is cheering it on.
lore.rare: Spills a little on the table on purpose whenever someone forgets to say please.
lore.epic: Brewed tea so strong at a garden party that the biscuits stood up on their own and walked out.
lore.legendary: Brewed a pot so comforting that a thunderstorm stopped overhead to sit down and have a cup.

lore.common: Hums in the hallway with its lights on and its snacks in neat rows.
lore.uncommon: Rejects the same coin five times in a row and then takes it without a fuss.
lore.rare: Ignores the buttons and hands out whatever it thinks people need, which is mostly raisins.
lore.epic: Dropped every snack at once when a fly landed on the button, and the school hallway became a free picnic.
lore.legendary: Stocked itself overnight with snacks nobody has ever invented, and the crisps taste of Wednesday.

lore.common: Clamps shut on batter and makes a grid of little squares.
lore.uncommon: Oozes batter out of its sides whenever it is overfilled.
lore.rare: Prints a waffle grid on anything it touches, so the tea towel, the newspaper and the cat's bed come out in neat squares.
lore.epic: Made a waffle so big that it became the dance floor at the birthday party, and the syrup made everyone stick.
lore.legendary: Pressed the snowy hill into perfect squares overnight, so the whole town went sledging down a giant waffle.

lore.common: Glugs a big bubble up its bottle every time a cup is filled.
lore.uncommon: Gathers a little crowd round it every afternoon.
lore.rare: Burps out the last secret said beside it, in one loud gulp, just as the boss walks past.
lore.epic: Burped a bubble so big that it floated off with the office plant and was last seen over the car park.
lore.legendary: Held so many office secrets that when it burped them all out at once, the whole company swapped jobs.

lore.common: Showers plants gently with its rose and drips on its owner's feet.
lore.uncommon: Is too heavy to lift when full, so it gets filled only halfway.
lore.rare: Makes whatever it waters grow a bit too fast, so the lawn needs mowing every hour.
lore.epic: Watered the garden gnome by mistake, and it grew so tall that it now waves at passing planes.
lore.legendary: Watered a single bean that grew through the clouds, and the giant at the top asked for a refill.

lore.common: Hums quietly in the corner, cleaning air nobody can see.
lore.uncommon: Lights up red whenever someone makes toast too dark.
lore.rare: Sucks up every smell in the house, including dinner, so the chips are always a surprise.
lore.epic: Cleared the house after a burnt dinner, and the smoke alarm stopped sulking.
lore.legendary: Cleaned the air over town so well that everyone could see the mountains for the first time. One turned out to be a cloud.

names.legendary: The Tap That Was Always Just Right

lore.common: Has one tap for hot and one for cold, and neither is ever quite right.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks like a mouse whenever it's turned, so the cat waits beside the bath.
lore.rare: Goes from cold to boiling in a second, so the bather has to dance.
lore.epic: Was turned so far that it shot the rubber duck through the bathroom window and into next door's pond.
lore.legendary: Ran a bath that was exactly the right temperature, which no tap had ever managed before.

lore.common: Comes in a tin with orange sauce and ends up on a slice of toast.
lore.uncommon: Always has one bean that escapes the spoon and hides under the toast.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it toot a little tune, and it is always the same tune.
lore.epic: Slid out of the tin in one perfect cylinder, and the family used it as a door stop for a week.
lore.legendary: Fed a hungry giant on a snowy night from one tin, and the giant has been tooting the same tune ever since.

lore.common: Is a huge mug with a little metal lid that flips up and down.
lore.uncommon: Snaps its lid shut on the nose of whoever drinks from it.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who lifts it want to sing a loud song.
lore.epic: Was clinked so hard at the summer fair that it rang like a bell, and the school came out thinking it was home time.
lore.legendary: Flipped its lid so hard that the lid flew round the world and landed back on top, slightly sunburnt.

names.legendary: The Bowl Nobody Knew How to Use

lore.common: Sits next to the toilet in holiday flats and confuses every visitor.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a foot bath by every child who finds it.
lore.rare: Changes what it is for every time someone asks, and nobody has ever got the same answer twice.
lore.epic: Was turned on full by a curious toddler and launched the soap, the flannel and Dad's sunglasses onto the balcony.
lore.legendary: Was used for so many things on one holiday that it was a sink, a foot bath and a fish pond.

lore.common: Is so thin that light shines through it when it's held up.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle so tiny that only one finger fits, and it is never the right finger.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who drinks from it hold their little finger out.
lore.epic: Was carried across a garden party so carefully that a snail overtook the person carrying it.
lore.legendary: Made everyone so polite with one sip that a pirate ship moored up for tea and handed back all its treasure.

lore.common: Has rice, beans and a little bit of everything piled high in it.
lore.uncommon: Gets so full that the first forkful sends half of it over the side.
lore.rare: Makes every forkful hotter than the last, so the final bite comes with its own fire alarm.
lore.epic: Was packed so heavy that the delivery bike did a wheelie all the way down the high street.
lore.legendary: Held a whole birthday party inside it: rice, beans, a band and a bouncy castle made of tortilla.

lore.common: Is so dented that it rocks on the table like a boat in a storm.
lore.uncommon: Clinks on everything in the rucksack and keeps everyone awake.
lore.rare: Calls every squirrel in the forest with one clink, and they all want a sip.
lore.epic: Was left on the camp stove so long that it glowed, and the whole campsite toasted marshmallows on it.
lore.legendary: Fell off a mountain top, bounced off two clouds and landed upright beside the tent, still full of tea.

lore.common: Rattles in its box and crunches loudly in the bowl.
lore.uncommon: Goes soggy in exactly the time it takes to find a spoon.
lore.rare: Lures every person in the house downstairs with the rattle of its box before the bowl is even out.
lore.epic: Was poured so fast that it went all over the table, and the dog had breakfast too.
lore.legendary: Crunched so loudly that it woke the street, the street woke the town, and the town woke the sun an hour early.

lore.common: Unfolds in the lounge and covers itself in damp socks and pants.
lore.uncommon: Takes up so much room that everyone squeezes past it sideways.
lore.rare: Dries clothes so slowly in winter that they are ready just in time for the next wash.
lore.epic: Was so full of washing that the family had to crawl under it to reach the sofa.
lore.legendary: Held so much washing on a windy day that it took off like a kite and dried the clothes over the whole coast.

lore.common: Crunches in a creamy heap next to every barbecue plate.
lore.uncommon: Gets left in the fridge until it goes a bit sad and watery.
lore.rare: Shreds anything it is served beside, so the burger arrives in thin strips and the napkin comes as confetti.
lore.epic: Slid off a paper plate at the barbecue and landed on Grandad's head like a creamy wig.
lore.legendary: Shredded a whole cabbage field in one afternoon, and the farmer had to sell it as the world's biggest side salad.

lore.common: Holds a little milk for the tea and dribbles some down its own side.
lore.uncommon: Pours one drop too many every time, so the tea goes pale.
lore.rare: Curdles the coffee of anyone who is grumpy, so the whole office knows who got out of bed on the wrong side.
lore.epic: Poured so many milk clouds into one cafe's cups that it started to drizzle on the customers.
lore.legendary: Poured a swirl that spun so fast it became a tiny tornado and tidied the whole cafe before closing time.

lore.common: Bubbles in its bowl with a smell that reaches next door.
lore.uncommon: Is always hotter than the cook said it would be.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who eats it puff out a little cloud of steam with every word, like a friendly dragon.
lore.epic: Was so spicy at curry night that everyone's hair stood on end, and the family photo looks like a row of hedgehogs.
lore.legendary: Was cooked so hot that the snow melted off the whole street, and the neighbours came out in shorts in January.

names.legendary: The Machine That Dried the House

lore.common: Hums in the corner, slowly filling its little tank with water from the air.
lore.uncommon: Beeps when its tank is full, usually at two in the morning.
lore.rare: Drinks the water out of anything nearby, so the bath shrinks, the tea goes thick and the houseplants glare at it.
lore.epic: Pulled so much damp out of a rainy afternoon that the clouds outside gave up and went home early.
lore.legendary: Dried a whole damp house in a week, and the mould packed its bags and left.

lore.common: Holds wet plates and cups while they drip onto the draining board.
lore.uncommon: Has one slot that is never the right size for the plate.
lore.rare: Rearranges the plates overnight from biggest to smallest, so nobody can find their own mug in the morning.
lore.epic: Collapsed under a pile of party plates, and the kitchen sounded like a cymbal solo.
lore.legendary: Stacked the plates so high that the tower reached the Moon, and the astronauts finally had somewhere to put their cups.

lore.common: Shoots a little arc of water up for anyone thirsty enough to lean in.
lore.uncommon: Shoots water straight up the nose of whoever presses it too hard.
lore.rare: Runs ice cold for anyone who pushed in the queue and pleasantly cool for everyone who waited.
lore.epic: Got stuck on full on sports day and filled the long-jump pit, so the long jump became the long swim.
lore.legendary: Sprayed a jet so high that it watered the clouds, and the school now gets its own little shower every break time.

lore.common: Holds a boiled egg upright and waits for toast soldiers.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles so that the egg rolls out when the top is tapped.
lore.rare: Draws a little face on any egg put in it, and the faces always look surprised when the top comes off.
lore.epic: Was topped so hard that the egg flew off, bounced round the kitchen and landed back in the cup, still runny.
lore.legendary: Kept a breakfast egg so warm and safe that it hatched, and the chick now sits in the cup every morning waiting for toast.

lore.common: Chips off one more white speckle every time it is dropped, and it is dropped a lot.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot to hold when it's filled with tea straight from the fire.
lore.rare: Makes any drink in it taste of woodsmoke, even orange juice at the kitchen table.
lore.epic: Was used to bail out a leaky rowing boat and got the whole family back to shore, with tea leaves in their socks.
lore.legendary: Sat by so many campfires that it learned to boil water on its own, and now it makes tea whenever it hears a tent zip.

lore.common: Comes on its own tiny saucer and looks like a cup made for a doll's tea party.
lore.uncommon: Gets drunk in one sip before anyone can even put it down.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who sips it talk twice as fast, so a five-minute phone call is over in two and a half.
lore.epic: Was sipped so fast before a train that its owner overtook the train and had to wait for it at the next station.
lore.legendary: Held one drop of coffee so strong that a sleeping volcano woke up, yawned and asked for another.

lore.common: Buzzes and bubbles under tired feet after a long day.
lore.uncommon: Splashes water across the floor whenever it's switched on too high.
lore.rare: Tickles the soles of anyone who puts their feet in, and they can't stop giggling until the water goes cold.
lore.epic: Bubbled so hard on full power that it shot Grandad's slippers into the ceiling light, where they still hang.
lore.legendary: Bubbled the old dog's paws so well that he came out with a puppy's bounce and beat the postman to the door for the first time ever.

lore.common: Has peas, egg and little crispy bits all mixed into its rice.
lore.uncommon: Has one pea that falls off the fork every time.
lore.rare: Flicks grains of rice off the plate whenever a fork comes near, and they end up in everyone's hair.
lore.epic: Was tossed so high in the wok that half of it landed on the roof, and the pigeons have been loyal customers ever since.
lore.legendary: Was tossed so high that it went into orbit and came back down one grain at a time for a week, like tasty snow.

lore.common: Sits on the outside wall and drips onto the path.
lore.uncommon: Is always too stiff to turn on and too loose to turn off.
lore.rare: Gushes so hard when opened that the hose leaps out of its owner's hand.
lore.epic: Was turned on so hard that the hose wriggled across the lawn like a snake and chased the cat up a tree.
lore.legendary: Pushed water uphill so hard that it filled a lake at the top of the mountain, and the town now goes up there to paddle.

lore.common: Crunches in the bowl in little honey-sweet clusters.
lore.uncommon: Leaves bits stuck in teeth all the way until lunch.
lore.rare: Glues honey clusters to everything it touches, so the spoon, the bowl and the dog end up stuck together.
lore.epic: Was baked into one cluster so big that the family now uses it as a garden bench.
lore.legendary: Fuelled a hiker so well that he walked up a mountain, down the other side and halfway across the sea before noticing.

lore.common: Sails round the dinner table full of gravy, dripping from its spout.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up in front of the one person at the table who doesn't want any gravy.
lore.rare: Floats on the gravy it has poured and steers itself to whoever likes gravy least.
lore.epic: Poured so much gravy at Sunday lunch that the peas formed a lifeboat crew to rescue the sausages.
lore.legendary: Was launched as a real ship and sailed round the world serving gravy to every lighthouse keeper on the way.

lore.common: Puffs a soft mist into the air of the bedroom.
lore.uncommon: Fogs up the windows so that nobody can see out in the morning.
lore.rare: Turns any word spoken near it into a puff of mist that hangs in the air until someone reads it.
lore.epic: Was left on all night, and the bedroom woke up as a rainforest with a parrot on the wardrobe.
lore.legendary: Made a cloud so fluffy that the cat climbed onto it, and it has floated round the house ever since, refusing to come down.

lore.common: Saves the bits at the bottom for the very last sip, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by the cereal box nearly every morning.
lore.rare: Makes juice look so bright that the sun comes out to have a look.
lore.epic: Tipped over at breakfast, and the juice spelled out GOOD MORNING across the table before soaking into the toast.
lore.legendary: Was held up to the window so often that the sun mistook it for a little sun and now rises in it every morning.

lore.common: Has layers of pasta, sauce and cheese that slide apart when it's cut.
lore.uncommon: Is too hot to eat for at least twenty minutes after it comes out.
lore.rare: Swaps the order of its layers when nobody is looking, so the cheese ends up on the bottom and the pasta on top.
lore.epic: Was carried to a party so heavy that the table sagged in the middle, and the jelly slid down to meet it.
lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that a lift had to be built to reach the top layer, and the lift attendant gets the crispy corner.

lore.common: Is scratchy and spongy and hangs on a string in the shower.
lore.uncommon: Takes days to dry and never quite stops dripping.
lore.rare: Grows back like the plant it came from if left on a sunny windowsill, and has started climbing the shower curtain.
lore.epic: Scrubbed a mud-covered rugby team so clean that the referee couldn't tell which side was which.
lore.legendary: Scrubbed an old shipwreck so clean that it floated back up and sailed itself into the harbour.

lore.common: Is cheesy and creamy, and its crust gets fought over.
lore.uncommon: Gets cold so fast that the cheese turns solid.
lore.rare: Melts any cheese within a metre, so the sandwich beside it and the party cheese board slide onto the floor.
lore.epic: Set solid overnight at a sleepover, and the children used the bowl as a bowling ball.
lore.legendary: Was baked in a pan so big that the village used it as a swimming pool, and the lifeguard ate the crust.

names.legendary: Stiletta, Who Stood Through the Quake

lore.common: Has a wide pointy bowl that tips over at the slightest wobble.
lore.uncommon: Is so wide that half its drink spills before it reaches the table.
lore.rare: Turns any drink poured into it bright blue, even milk, even soup.
lore.epic: Was clinked so hard at a fancy dinner that its olive shot across the room and landed in the guest of honour's soup.
lore.legendary: Stood upright on its pointy foot through an earthquake at a fancy dinner, and was the only thing in the room still standing.

lore.common: Has lines for millilitres, cups and pints, and every one of them is slightly wrong.
lore.uncommon: Gets used for juice once and for gravy the next day.
lore.rare: Measures more than liquids: pour in a bad mood and it tells you exactly how many millilitres of grumpy you are.
lore.epic: Was used to bail out a flooded kitchen and counted every drop: 412 litres, two goldfish and a sock.
lore.legendary: Measured the rain in the garden so carefully one summer that the weather forecaster rang to ask for its numbers.

lore.common: Leaves a white moustache on everyone who drinks from it.
lore.uncommon: Gets left on the bedside table and goes a bit sour by the morning.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who drinks a whole glass feel strong enough to carry the shopping in one trip.
lore.epic: Gave the cat a milk moustache so big that it was mistaken for a tiny grandad at the bus stop.
lore.legendary: Built bones so strong in one gulp that its drinker carried the broken-down school bus home on his back.

lore.common: Is warm and gloopy and is always eaten with a heap of honey.
lore.uncommon: Swells up in the bowl, so a small serving always turns into a big one.
lore.rare: Sets as hard as cement if it is left alone, and the builders next door now borrow it for walls.
lore.epic: Was cooked in a pot so big at scout camp that the whole troop had to stir it with a canoe paddle.
lore.legendary: Was so warming that a snowman ate a bowl and came indoors to sit by the fire.

lore.common: Is golden yellow with peas, peppers and a crispy bottom.
lore.uncommon: Has one prawn on top that everyone pretends not to want.
lore.rare: Sticks the pan to the stove so firmly that it has to be served where it stands, and the guests eat round the cooker.
lore.epic: Was cooked in a pan so wide that it needed its own parking space at the beach party.
lore.legendary: Was cooked in a pan so big that a fishing boat sailed into it by mistake, and the crew stayed for lunch.

lore.common: Steams with broth, noodles and a pile of fresh herbs on top.
lore.uncommon: Drops its fresh herbs into the broth one by one, until the last spoonful is a salad.
lore.rare: Fogs up the glasses of anyone who leans over it, and they stay fogged until the bowl is empty.
lore.epic: Was filled so full that the waiter carried it across the restaurant like a tightrope walker, and the whole room held its breath.
lore.legendary: Simmered so long that its broth became a hot spring, and the town now goes there to bathe among the noodles.

lore.common: Stands by the toilet waiting for an emergency, which it secretly enjoys.
lore.uncommon: Makes a loud schlurp sound whenever it's pulled up.
lore.rare: Sticks itself to whatever it touches, so the fridge, the cat flap and the front door have all been plunged.
lore.epic: Pulled so hard on a blocked drain that the whole street's pipes came up like spaghetti.
lore.legendary: Stuck to the Moon by accident and pulled it a little closer, so the tides are slightly higher on bath night.

lore.common: Bubbles in the pan and sticks to the bottom if left for a moment.
lore.uncommon: Is always either too hot or too cold, never quite right.
lore.rare: Blows a raspberry at anyone who tries to eat it before it has cooled down.
lore.epic: Set so solid at breakfast that the bowl turned over in one piece, and the family used it as a hat stand.
lore.legendary: Was finally just right, not too hot and not too cold, and three bears walked fifty miles to complain about it.

lore.common: Has noodles, broth and a perfectly cooked egg floating on top.
lore.uncommon: Hides its egg under the noodles whenever a spoon comes near.
lore.rare: Whistles like a kettle when it's ready, and keeps whistling until somebody says thank you.
lore.epic: Was made with so many noodles that they hung over the side and down the stairs, and the dog had a midnight feast.
lore.legendary: Was slurped so loudly that the sound bounced off the Moon and came back as an order for two more bowls.

lore.common: Hums over the cooker and sucks up steam and smells.
lore.uncommon: Drips a little grease onto the cooker if its filter isn't cleaned.
lore.rare: Sucks up more than steam: tea towels, recipe cards and once the cook's hat have all gone up the chimney.
lore.epic: Sucked up the smell of a Sunday roast and blew it over the street, and the neighbours turned up with plates.
lore.legendary: Sucked a pancake off the pan mid-flip, and it was found next morning on top of the town clock.

lore.common: Rings like a little bell when chopsticks tap it, so everyone knows who wants seconds.
lore.uncommon: Gets a grain of rice stuck to its rim that nobody notices.
lore.rare: Keeps its rice so warm and fluffy that it gets fluffier every day until it floats off the table.
lore.epic: Was piled so high that the grains rolled off like an avalanche and buried the soy sauce up to its lid.
lore.legendary: Refilled itself for every hungry person in the village, and the rice cooker took early retirement.

lore.common: Needs stirring every minute, so the cook can never leave the pan.
lore.uncommon: Takes forty minutes to make and three minutes to eat.
lore.rare: Makes the cook's arm keep stirring by itself, hours after dinner, even in bed.
lore.epic: Was stirred so long at a dinner party that the guests fell asleep before it was ready.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole river one spoonful at a time, and the cook still said it needed more stock.

lore.common: Hums and whirrs as the needle goes up and down at speed.
lore.uncommon: Tangles its thread underneath whenever someone is in a hurry.
lore.rare: Sews anything left near the needle, so the curtains, the tablecloth and the cat's blanket are all joined together.
lore.epic: Stitched a whole school play's costumes overnight but sewed every one inside out, so the play was performed backwards.
lore.legendary: Stitched a patch on the sky where it was leaking, and it hasn't rained on sports day since.

lore.common: Is covered in pins, fabric scraps and a tape measure that won't roll up.
lore.uncommon: Has a drawer full of buttons that spills whenever it's opened.
lore.rare: Swaps the buttons on any shirt left on it, so every shirt comes back with odd ones.
lore.epic: Measured the house with its tape measure while the family slept, and the kitchen came out two metres longer.
lore.legendary: Measured a snake so long that its tape measure ran out of numbers and started using letters.

lore.common: Is a tiny heavy glass with a thick bottom that clinks on the table.
lore.uncommon: Is so small that it gets mistaken for an egg cup, and the egg sits on top looking worried.
lore.rare: Shrinks any drink poured into it, so a whole jug of juice fits inside and comes out as one sip.
lore.epic: Was turned upside down to catch a spider, and the spider moved in and put up curtains.
lore.legendary: Holds a whole thundercloud squeezed into one tiny glass, and it rumbles if anyone puts it down too hard.

lore.common: Starts cold for ten seconds before deciding to be warm.
lore.uncommon: Changes temperature whenever someone flushes the toilet.
lore.rare: Rains on whoever is standing next to the shower too, wherever they are in the house.
lore.epic: Went cold in the middle of a hair wash, and the shriek woke the neighbours.
lore.legendary: Rained so warmly one winter morning that a cloud flew in through the window to have a shower.

lore.common: Sprays water in a dozen little jets, two of which go sideways.
lore.uncommon: Gets blocked by limescale until it only works on one side.
lore.rare: Changes the smell of the water every morning, and Tuesdays always smell of onions.
lore.epic: Was set to full power and peeled the wallpaper off the bathroom, revealing a door nobody knew was there.
lore.legendary: Sprayed so hard one morning that the water went backwards up the pipes and gave the water tower a shower.

lore.common: Holds soup instead of tea, which confuses visitors.
lore.uncommon: Gets too hot to hold, so its owner wraps it in their sleeve.
lore.rare: Swaps its soup for a different flavour whenever someone stirs it the wrong way round.
lore.epic: Steamed so much on a cold bus that the windows fogged, and the driver followed the smell of tomato to the depot.
lore.legendary: Chased a whole winter out of town with one steaming mugful, and spring turned up a month early with a runny nose.

lore.common: Squishes and soaks and gets smaller every week.
lore.uncommon: Starts to smell a bit funny if it is not left out to dry.
lore.rare: Takes on the colour of whatever it wipes, so it has been tomato red, spinach green and, once, tartan.
lore.epic: Swelled up so much in the sink after a dinner party that the kitchen window had to come out to get it outside.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole flood in one go and wrung it out over the desert, which now has a lake and a beach.

lore.common: Holds sugar lumps and a pair of tiny tongs that nobody can use properly.
lore.uncommon: Gets a wet spoon dipped into it, so the sugar turns into rocks.
lore.rare: Sweetens every drink within arm's reach, so the coffee, the gravy and the soup all taste of sugar.
lore.epic: Lost every sugar lump to a sneaky toddler at a tea party, and nobody's tea was sweet that day.
lore.legendary: Sweetened a lemon so thoroughly that it packed its bags and went to live with the oranges.

lore.common: Is heavy and made of pewter, with a handle big enough for a whole fist.
lore.uncommon: Clanks on the table so loudly that everyone looks up.
lore.rare: Makes whoever lifts it shout 'huzzah!
lore.epic: Was banged on the table at the harvest fair so hard that every apple fell off the trees in the orchard next door.
lore.legendary: Spotted a dragon through its glass bottom just in time, and the whole village had the kettle on before it landed.

lore.common: Clinks on its saucer every time it's lifted for a sip.
lore.uncommon: Spills a little tea into the saucer whenever it's carried.
lore.rare: Reads the future in its tea leaves, but only about biscuits.
lore.epic: Rattled on its saucer so hard at a tea party that it walked off the table and down the garden path.
lore.legendary: Rattled on its saucer in such perfect code that it ordered a cake from the bakery across the road.

lore.common: Has a teapot, cups and saucers that all match, except one.
lore.uncommon: Has one cup with a chip that always goes to the visitor.
lore.rare: Sets itself out on the table whenever visitors are coming, before anyone knows they are coming.
lore.epic: Threw a tea party for the garden's teddy bears so grand that the real neighbours queued at the fence to get in.
lore.legendary: Hosted one tea party for so long that the guests' grandchildren arrived for the final cup, and the cake was still fresh.

lore.common: Leans out from behind the toilet to tickle the ankles of anyone sitting down.
lore.uncommon: Drips onto the floor whenever it's put back too quickly.
lore.rare: Makes the toilet hum a sea shanty every time it is scrubbed.
lore.epic: Scrubbed a whole bathroom before a party, and the guests complimented the toilet.
lore.legendary: Scrubbed every toilet on a cruise ship in one night, and the captain made it first mate.

lore.common: Keeps coffee warm on the way to work and spills a bit at every bump.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that never quite clicks shut.
lore.rare: Keeps tea so warm that it's still too hot to drink by the time work starts.
lore.epic: Was dropped on the platform and bounced back up without spilling a drop.
lore.legendary: Kept its coffee hot for so long that divers found it on the seabed years later, still steaming.

lore.common: Splashes water in the park with a little arc that sparkles in the sun.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water onto everyone who walks past on a windy day.
lore.rare: Sprays its water into the shape of whatever the nearest child is thinking about, which is mostly ice cream.
lore.epic: Had bubble bath tipped into it by a prankster, and the park disappeared under foam up to the top of the swings.
lore.legendary: Danced its water so well at the park's birthday that the statue in the middle climbed down to join in.

lore.common: Squeaks loudly whenever its handle is pumped up and down.
lore.uncommon: Takes ten pumps before any water comes out.
lore.rare: Pumps up whatever is underground, so sometimes it's water, sometimes buried treasure and once a very confused worm.
lore.epic: Was pumped so hard at the village fair that a jet shot over the bunting and soaked the brass band mid-tune.
lore.legendary: Pumped up an underground river so fast that the village had a new stream by lunchtime and a ferry by teatime.

lore.common: Has no stem, so it sits low and round on the picnic blanket.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles in circles for ages after being put down, like a spinning top.
lore.rare: Rolls itself across the table to whoever is thirstiest, even if they are on the far side of the room.
lore.epic: Rolled off a picnic blanket at the top of a hill and knocked over a whole game of skittles at the bottom.
lore.legendary: Held its juice dead level through a whole rollercoaster ride, and the juice was the only one on the ride that didn't scream.
